triples.subject: Alexey Karamazov
triples.quote: Katerina Ivanovna’s commission took him to Lake Street, and his brother Dmitri lived close by, in a turning out of Lake Street.

triples.subject: Father Zossima
triples.quote: And Father Zossima sent me to reconcile and bring them together. Is this the way to bring them together?

triples.subject: Nikolay Ilyitch Snegiryov
triples.quote: And do you suppose I’d thrash him? That I’d take my Ilusha and thrash him before you for your satisfaction?

triples.subject: Ilusha
triples.quote: I asked him what I had done to him. And then he rushed at me and bit my finger badly, I don’t know why.

triples.subject: Dmitri Fyodorovitch Karamazov
triples.quote: So your boy is a good boy, he loves his father, and he attacked me as the brother of your assailant.

triples.subject: Ilusha
triples.quote: So your boy is a good boy, he loves his father, and he attacked me as the brother of your assailant.

triples.subject: Nikolay Ilyitch Snegiryov
triples.quote: At last he found the house in Lake Street. It was a decrepit little house, sunk on one side

triples.subject: Dmitri Fyodorovitch
triples.quote: my brother Dmitri Fyodorovitch regrets his action, I know that, and if only it is possible for him to come to you

triples.subject: Alexey Fyodorovitch Karamazov
triples.quote: my brother Dmitri Fyodorovitch regrets his action, I know that, and if only it is possible for him to come to you

triples.subject: Nikolay Ilyitch
triples.quote: So your boy is a good boy, he loves his father, and he attacked me as the brother of your assailant.

triples.subject: Nikolay Ilyitch
triples.quote: Wait a little, Varvara!” cried her father, speaking peremptorily but looking at her quite approvingly.

triples.subject: Nikolay Ilyitch
triples.quote: This girl sitting here is my daughter Nina; I forgot to introduce her to you.

triples.subject: Ilusha
triples.quote: So your boy is a good boy, he loves his father, and he attacked me as the brother of your assailant.

triples.subject: Ilusha
triples.quote: There’s only Ilusha who comes home from school and loves me. Yesterday he brought me an apple.

triples.subject: Ilusha
triples.quote: he attacked me as the brother of your assailant.... Now I understand it,” he repeated thoughtfully.

triples.subject: Dmitri Fyodorovitch
triples.quote: After pulling out my beard, you mean, he will ask my forgiveness? And he thinks that will be a satisfactory finish, doesn’t he?

triples.subject: Nikolay Ilyitch
triples.quote: But now let me present you to my wife, Arina Petrovna. She is crippled, she is forty-three
